Photon is a cross-platform file-transfer application. It uses http to transfer files between devices.You can transfer files between devices that run Photon. No wifi router is required, you can use hotspot.
 Features include e.g.:
 Cross-platform support: For instance you can transfer files between Android and Windows
 Transfer multiple files: You can pick any number of files.
 Pick files faster: Most of the apps use file_picker for picking the files. But for android it caches files before retrieving the paths. No matter how many files are selected ,paths will be retrieved within no time. (Note:Caching issue is android specific)
 Smooth UI: Material You design.

No external client like browser can get the files using url,as secret code is associated with url. It will be regenerated for every session.
 Supports high-speed data transfer: Photon is capable of transferring files at a very high rate but it depends upon the wifi bandwidth. (No internet connection required)

fdroid:biz.binarysolutions.healthybatter.name: Healthy Battery Charging
fdroid:biz.binarysolutions.healthybatter.summary: Prolong the life of your battery by keeping it charged between 40% and 80%
fdroid:biz.binarysolutions.healthybatter.description:
Make your smartphone or tablet battery last longer!
Good range to aim for when charging a Li-ion battery is from about 40 to 80 percent in one go. A bunch of tiny charges throughout the day is your second best bet, and going from zero to 100 and then 100 to zero on a regular basis will put the most strain on your lithium-ion battery.
Healthy Battery Charging notifies you when to plug or unplug your phone from the charger in order to improve the battery life. The app itself is optimized for low battery consumption, running in the background and checking the battery level every 15 minutes (configurable). The exact timing of these checks depends on the Android OS, which might schedule them alongside other tasks or delay them when in sleep mode. As a result, the battery level may slightly exceed the high threshold while charging or drop slightly below the low threshold while discharging before you receive a notification.
For those who want to know more technical details about Li-ion batteries:
https://batteryuniversity.com/learn/article/how_to_prolong_lithium_based_batteries

fdroid:com.aka.alarm.name: aka Alarm
fdroid:com.aka.alarm.summary: Wakes you within a 30-min window when you start stirring
fdroid:com.aka.alarm.description:
aka Alarm wakes you at the right moment within a 30-minute window you choose, instead of jolting you out of bed at a fixed time.
How it works: while an alarm is armed the app uses the microphone to measure the ambient sound level of your room. It maintains a rolling 5-minute baseline of "how quiet it really is" and watches for the level to rise above that baseline by a configurable threshold. When that happens — you turn over, sigh, shift the duvet — the alarm fires. If nothing happens, the alarm fires at the end of the window so you never oversleep.
Privacy: the microphone is active only while an alarm is set, and audio is processed in memory then immediately discarded. No audio buffer is ever written to disk, persisted, or transmitted off your device. There is no network code in this app at all — no analytics, no crash reporting, no third-party SDKs.
Features:
• Wake-up window with smart spike detection on the microphone
• 60-second gradual volume fade-in for the alarm tone
• Motion-driven snooze (lightly move the phone) with random duration clamped to the remaining window
• Slide up anywhere to dismiss
• Foreground service keeps the alarm reliable overnight
• Material 3 UI with dark + light mode
aka Alarm is open source under the MIT licence: https://github.com/seeingred/aka-alarm

fdroid:com.phonepvr.friends.description:
Bondwidth is an all-in-one phone, contacts, and relationship app that works entirely on your device. No accounts, no servers, no tracking — and it quietly helps you stay close to the people who matter.
Friendship is small attentions, often. Set a check-in cadence for each person and Bondwidth gently flags who's getting too quiet, so you can reach out before silence becomes a habit. Birthdays and anniversaries are remembered for you, and the calls you make are counted automatically.
Private by design
* No internet permission at all — the app cannot reach the network, and its build pipeline fails if that ever changes.
* No accounts, no servers, no cloud. Everything stays in the app's private storage on your device.
* No analytics, no ads, no third-party trackers.
* Optional encrypted backups (AES-256-GCM) that only you can open.
* Optional biometric app lock and a "hide from screenshots" mode.
Phone
* Default dialer with its own in-call screen, Picture-in-Picture, and per-contact ringtones.
* T9 smart dial, speed dial, and dual-SIM call routing.
* Block numbers, missed-call notifications, call history and search.
* Colour-coded call directions, with optional WhatsApp / Signal shortcuts.
Contacts
* Browse, create, edit and delete contacts, with group filtering.
* Typed phone numbers, emails, postal address, website, organisation, notes and birthday.
* Find and merge duplicates; import and export vCard files.
Bonds
* Per-person check-in cadence with gentle overdue nudges.
* Birthday and anniversary reminders, with a "Mark as wished" action.
* An interaction timeline and an at-a-glance relationship dashboard.
* A home-screen widget for upcoming occasions and who you haven't spoken to lately.
Bondwidth is free software (GPL-3.0). Its phone and contacts features are derived from the Fossify Phone and Fossify Contacts projects.

fdroid:io.github.digitalvalut.logos.name: DigitalValut Logos
fdroid:io.github.digitalvalut.logos.summary: Encrypted peer-to-peer chat and calls. No account, no server, no phone number.
fdroid:io.github.digitalvalut.logos.description:
Peer-to-peer encrypted chat, voice and video calls, and file sharing — directly
between two devices, with no account, no phone number, and no server that ever
sees a message.
Two browsers negotiate a private WebRTC connection and talk to each other
directly. A small relay only ever helps them find each other and, when an
unusually strict network requires it, forwards traffic that is already
encrypted and which it has no key to read. There is no database anywhere
holding conversations.
The relay is a Cloudflare Worker run by the project
(digitalvalut-turn.burbeng78.workers.dev); the connection helpers (STUN/TURN)
are Cloudflare's (stun.cloudflare.com, turn.cloudflare.com). The relay address
is fixed in the app. Its source is in the same repository (turn-worker/), so
anyone can run their own, but using it means rebuilding the app.
 How you reach someone 
A permanent address (DV-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) is the SHA-256 hash of a key pair
generated on the device, so it verifies itself: whoever dials it fetches the
published key, checks that it really hashes back to the address dialled, and
only then trusts it. A substituted key produces a different address and is
rejected. Up to eight throwaway addresses can be held alongside the permanent
one, each revocable on its own.
You can also connect by a tappable invite link, or by scanning a QR code in
person.
 Knowing who you are really talking to 
The first time you connect to someone, both sides see the same three-word
security code, derived from the actual cryptographic handshake — the same
principle used by ZRTP-based secure calling. Read them aloud once; if they
match, nobody is sitting in the middle. That check is bound to the other
person's cryptographic fingerprint, not to a display name.
 What it does 
• Text, emoji, voice messages, photos, video and files up to 512 MB, sent
 uncompressed at original quality
• Photos have their embedded GPS location, device model and software metadata
 stripped on-device before sending, without re-encoding the image
• Audio and video calls with screen sharing
• The phone rings even with the app closed, without Google and without Firebase:
 a service belonging to the app reads its own encrypted mailbox, and the
 question it asks has only yes or no for an answer. It holds no key and can
 read nothing; who is calling, and what they wrote, are read by the app when
 you open it. It uses more battery than a push notification would, and it is
 off until you turn it on
• A sealed letter for someone who does not answer, held up to 7 days, openable
 only by the address owner
• Self-destructing messages and optional automatic cleanup of old conversations
• Interface in 13 languages, with right-to-left layout for Arabic and Urdu
 Honest limits 
Both people need to be online at the same time for a live conversation. That is
the price of having no server, and it is architectural, not a bug.
Your IP address is visible to the person you connect to, as it is in any direct
peer-to-peer connection, unless you switch on "Hide where you are".
 About this package 
The entire application is inside this package. It is not a wrapper that opens a
website: the app is served from the package's own storage, so what runs on your
phone is what was built from the source in this repository, and it keeps working
when the website cannot be reached at all.
There is no push notification service anywhere in it — no Google Play Services,
no Firebase, no account. The only background service is the app's own, described
above, and it talks to nothing but the same relay the app already uses. Every
cryptographic primitive comes from the system's own Web Crypto implementation.
No third-party script, library or CDN resource is loaded at any point.
Built by Associazione di Promozione Sociale DigitalValut, an Italian nonprofit.
Free forever, with no account and nothing to buy.

fdroid:io.github.rastislavpapp.justopenl.summary: Sends links to your real browser instead of an app's built-in one
fdroid:io.github.rastislavpapp.justopenl.description:
Android apps love opening links in an in-app browser: a bare little window
inside the app, with one page, no tabs, no extensions, no history, and nothing
left when you close it.
This app sends those links to your real browser instead.
Set it as your default browser, then open it once to pick which of your
installed browsers links should go to. From then on, every link an app hands to
the system arrives in the browser you actually use, with your bookmarks, your
logins and your content blocker.
That is the whole app. There are no settings beyond that one choice. It has no
network access of its own, and contains no analytics, no advertising and no
tracking. It never loads a page: it passes the link on and gets out of the way.
One limit worth knowing about. Some apps do not hand the link to the system at
all and draw the page themselves. Facebook and Instagram are the usual
examples. Nothing installed on the device can redirect those, this app
included.

fdroid:org.strongswan.android.summary: An easy to use IKEv2/IPsec-based VPN client.
fdroid:org.strongswan.android.description:
Official Android port of the popular strongSwan VPN solution.
# FEATURES AND LIMITATIONS #
 Uses the VpnService API featured by Android 4+. Devices by some manufacturers seem to lack support for this - strongSwan VPN Client won't work on these devices!
 Uses the IKEv2 key exchange protocol
 Uses IPsec for data traffic
 Full support for changed connectivity and mobility through MOBIKE (or reauthentication)
 Supports username/password EAP authentication (namely EAP-MSCHAPv2, EAP-MD5 and EAP-GTC) as well as RSA/ECDSA private key/certificate authentication to authenticate users, EAP-TLS with client certificates is also supported
 Combined RSA/ECDSA and EAP authentication is supported by using two authentication rounds as defined in RFC 4739
 VPN server certificates are verified against the CA certificates pre-installed or installed by the user on the system. The CA or server certificates used to authenticate the server can also be imported directly into the app.
 IKEv2 fragmentation is supported if the VPN server supports it (strongSwan does so since 5.2.1)
 Split-tunneling allows sending only certain traffic through the VPN and/or excluding specific traffic from it
 Per-app VPN allows limiting the VPN connection to specific apps, or exclude them from using it
 The IPsec implementation currently supports the AES-CBC, AES-GCM, ChaCha20/Poly1305 and SHA1/SHA2 algorithms
 Passwords are currently stored as cleartext in the database (only if stored with a profile)
 VPN profiles may be imported from files
 Supports managed configurations via enterprise mobility management (EMM)
Details and a changelog can be found in our documentation: https://docs.strongswan.org/docs/latest/os/androidVpnClient.html
# PERMISSIONS #
 READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE: Allows importing VPN profiles and CA certificates from external storage on some Android versions
 QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES: Required on Android 11+ to select apps to ex-/include in VPN profiles and the optional EAP-TNC use case
# EXAMPLE SERVER CONFIGURATION #
Example server configurations may be found in our documentation: https://docs.strongswan.org/docs/latest/os/androidVpnClient.html#_server_configuration
Please note that the host name (or IP address) configured with a VPN profile in the app *must be* contained in the server certificate as subjectAltName extension.
# FEEDBACK #
Please post bug reports and feature requests via GitHub: https://github.com/strongswan/strongswan/issues/new/choose
If you do so, please include information about your device (manufacturer, model, OS version etc.).
The log file written by the key exchange service can be sent directly from within the application.

flathub:org.godotengine.Godot3.name: Godot 3

NOTE: This Flatpak is unofficial and not supported by Godot Engine developers. Find
 officially supported binaries on godotengine.org.
 The feature-packed, cross-platform game engine to create 2D and 3D games from a unified interface.
 Godot Engine provides a comprehensive set of common tools, so that you can focus on making games
 without having to reinvent the wheel. Games can be exported in one click to a number of platforms,
 including the major desktop platforms (Linux, macOS, Windows) as well as mobile (Android, iOS),
 web-based (HTML5) platforms and consoles (Switch, PS4 and Xbox One - via thirdparty publishers).
 Completely free and open source under the very permissive MIT license. No strings attached,
 no royalties, nothing. Your game is yours down to the last line of engine code. Godot's development
 is fully independent and community-driven, empowering you to help shape the engine to match your
 expectations. It is supported by the non-profit Godot Foundation.
 Create games with ease, using Godot's unique approach to game development:
 Nodes for all your needs. Godot comes with hundreds of built-in nodes that make game design
 a breeze. You can also create your own for custom behaviors, editors and much more.
 Flexible scene system. Create node compositions with support for instancing and inheritance.
 Visual editor with all the tools you need packed into a beautiful and uncluttered context-sensitive
 UI.
 Friendly content creation pipeline for artists, level designers, animators and everything
 in between.
 Persistent live editing where changes are not lost after stopping the game. It even works
 on mobile devices!
 Create your own custom tools with ease using the incredible tool system.
 Current limitations of the Flatpak version:
 For C#/Mono support, install org.godotengine.Godot3Sharp instead: https://flathub.org/apps/org.godotengine.Godot3Sharp

flathub:org.yamagi.YamagiQ2.name: Yamagi Quake II
flathub:org.yamagi.YamagiQ2.summary: Yamagi Quake II is an alternative client for id Software's Quake II
flathub:org.yamagi.YamagiQ2.description:
Yamagi Quake II is an alternative client for id Software's Quake II. Our goal is to provide the best Quake II experience possible, we strive to preserve the gameplay as it was back in 1997. Thus we aim mostly for bug fixes, stability and gentle enhancements were appropriate. Yamagi Quake II has a lot of unique features. The most notables ones are:
 A modern OpenGL 3.2 renderer, providing a greatly enhanced look and feel. The original OpenGL 1.4 and even the Software renderers are still supported. Both 3D accelerated renderers support anisotropic filtering and multisampling anti aliasing.
 Full support for widescreen displays and arbitrary resolutions. The HUD can be scaled to be readable on high resolutions. 
 Support for surround sound, from stereo up to 7.1 channels and even HRTF. The background music can be played from OGG/Vorbis files, a CD drive is no longer necessary.
 A rewritten savegame system. Yamagi Quake II savegames are completely reliable and backward compatible between releases as long as the principle architecture stays the same.
 Highly precise timings. For example, on a flat panel display with a 59.95 hertz refresh rate and vertical synchronisation (VSync) enabled Yamagi Quake II is running at exactly 59.95 frames per second.
 In comparison with the original client over 1.500 bugs were fixed. The Yamagi Quake II client is very well tested and stable. The dedicated server is able to run for weeks without a single restart. Last but not least the code is fully 64 bit clean and highly portable.
 Commercial data files are required to run the supported game. These can be aquired though a multitude of sources. See the manual for more info on this.

firefox-addons:667962.name: Browserling Web Testing & Cybersecurity
firefox-addons:667962.summary: Cross-browser test websites in the most popular browsers such as Internet Explorer, Edge, Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Opera. Try for free!
firefox-addons:667962.description:
Browserling Web Testing & Cybersecurity is a browser extension that lets you quickly test how the current website looks and behaves in different browsers, browser versions, and operating systems.
The extension integrates with Browserling and opens a remote browser testing session with the current page loaded. Select an available operating system, browser, and browser version to verify website compatibility without installing multiple browsers or configuring virtual machines on your computer.
It is designed for web developers, QA engineers, designers, and cybersecurity professionals who need to test websites across different browsing environments.
 Key Features 
- Test the current website in different browsers and browser versions
- Choose from available operating systems and browser environments
- Automatically opens the current page in a Browserling testing session
- No local virtual machines or additional browser installations required
- Simple popup interface for quick testing
- Fast access to remote browser sessions
 Popup 
 Opens when clicking the extension icon in the browser toolbar
 Provides options to select an operating system, browser, and browser version
 Automatically uses the URL of the currently active tab
 Opens the remote browser testing session in a new browser tab
 How It Works 
 Open the website you want to test.
 Click the Browserling icon in the browser toolbar.
 Select an operating system, browser, and browser version.
 Click the arrow button to start testing.
 A new tab opens with a Browserling remote browser session.
 Interact with the page to verify its layout, styles, and functionality.
 Permissions 
 activeTab — accesses the current tab URL so it can be opened in the remote testing session
 storage — stores extension preferences and state
 contextMenus — enables launching browser testing from the browser context menu
 No unrelated user data is collected or processed. 
 Notes 
- Works with the currently active browser tab
- Uses Browserling's remote browser testing environments
- Available browsers and operating systems depend on Browserling's service
- No local virtual machines or additional browser installations are required
- The extension does not need to install the target browsers on your computer
 About Browserling 
Browserling develops online browsers and browser-based tools used by developers, designers, cybersecurity professionals, and technical teams around the world. Browserling Web Testing & Cybersecurity is part of Browserling's collection of independently maintained, ad-free browser extensions built for long-term reliability. Our goal is to create simple, focused browser tools that make everyday testing and development tasks faster and easier.

firefox-addons:3024590.name: Escudo — Ad Blocker para YouTube
firefox-addons:3024590.summary: Bloqueador de anuncios para YouTube en tres capas: corta las conexiones a servidores de anuncios, poda los datos del reproductor en origen y vigila el DOM. Listas de filtros actualizables. Funciona en Firefox de escritorio y Android.
firefox-addons:3024590.description:
Escudo bloquea los anuncios de YouTube con un enfoque en TRES CAPAS que actúa antes de que el anuncio llegue a reproducirse:
1) RED — Corta los pedidos a los servidores de anuncios con reglas de red (declarativeNetRequest). El anuncio ni siquiera se descarga.
2) ORIGEN — Poda la respuesta del reproductor (/youtubei/v1/player) para quitar los datos de anuncios en la fuente, antes de que el video cargue.
3) DOM — Un vigía observa la página y limpia cualquier resto que se escape.
Funciona en YouTube de escritorio y en la versión móvil ( m.youtube.com ), tanto en Firefox como en Firefox para Android.
CARACTERÍSTICAS
 • Listas de filtros actualizables desde una URL que vos definís.
 • Lista de permitidos por canal: dejá pasar anuncios en los canales que quieras apoyar.
 • Sin recolección de datos: toda tu configuración se guarda localmente en tu navegador. No se envía nada a ningún servidor.
 • Liviana, sin seguimiento.
PRIVACIDAD
 Escudo no recopila información personal ni de navegación. No usa analítica ni rastreadores.

firefox-addons:2912765.name: Auto Tab Groups
firefox-addons:2912765.summary: 🔖 Automatically groups tabs by sub/domain, or by your own rules
firefox-addons:2912765.description:
Auto Tab Groups - Universal Extension
A cross-browser extension that automatically groups tabs by domain, supporting both Chrome and Firefox.
Bugs / Issues / Feature Requests
Please report any issues or feature requests using our feedback form .
If you like this extension, please consider rating it 5 stars ⭐ :)
🚀 Features
 ✅ Cross-browser compatibility - Single codebase for Chrome and Firefox
 ✅ Domain-based tab grouping - Automatically groups tabs by website domain/subdomain
 ✅ Custom rules - Create named groups that combine multiple domains
 ✅ Minimum tabs threshold - Set how many tabs are needed before creating a group (global and per-rule)
 ✅ Export/Import rules - Backup and restore your custom tab grouping rules
 ✅ Smart domain display - Shows clean domain names (e.g., "github" instead of " github.com ")
 ✅ Color management - Persistent group colors across browser sessions
 ✅ Collapse/expand controls - Manage tab group visibility
 ✅ Configuration options - Auto-grouping, subdomain handling, etc.
 ✅ Side panel support - Chrome side panel and Firefox sidebar
 ✅ Modern UI - Clean, responsive interface

firefox-addons:2933122.name: Per-Tab Volume Controller
firefox-addons:2933122.summary: Take control of your browser's audio experience with per-tab volume management. Set custom volume levels for each website, and enjoy precise fine-tuning with 0.1% increments. Perfect for managing multiple audio sources across different tabs.
firefox-addons:2933122.description:
Volume Controller gives you granular control over audio playback across all your browser tabs. Whether you're watching videos, listening to music, or browsing content with sound, this extension lets you set custom volume levels for each website individually.
 Key Features: 
* Adjust volume per tab with a simple slider and button interface
* Fine-tune audio with 0.1% precision when fine control is enabled
* Save volume settings automatically per website (optional)
* Quick access via context menu (right-click tab)
- Multiple match types for saved rules:
 - Domain : Match entire website (e.g., example.com )
 - Contains : Match URLs with keywords (e.g., watch?v=)
 - Exact : Match specific URLs
 - Regex : Advanced pattern matching
- Customizable theme : Dark, light, or auto (follow system)
- Session history : Track your recent volume adjustments
 Perfect for: 
* Managing multiple video tabs with different volume needs
* Setting lower volumes for music while keeping videos loud
* Creating consistent audio experiences across your favorite sites
* Developers and power users who need precise audio control
 How to Use: 
1. Click the extension icon in your toolbar for the popup
2. Right-click any tab and select "Volume Control" for quick presets
4. Enable "Remember volume per website" in options to auto-save settings
5. In options, manage saved sites and create custom URL rules
Your volume preferences are saved and restored when you revisit sites. No more juggling different volume levels across multiple tabs!

apple-macos:1332483673.name: Center Meditation Timer
apple-macos:1332483673.description:
Center is a silent meditation timer for serious practice.
No guides, no voices, no lessons, and no music. Center exists for people who already know why they meditate and want a calm, precise tool to support long-term practice.
Start a session in one tap. Practice in silence or with simple bells. Customize session lengths, intervals, sounds, and themes to match your ritual.
Center works across all Apple platforms and stays out of your way.
# Designed for real practice
• Silent timer with optional bells and intervals
• Fully customizable session lengths
• Minimal interface with multiple themes
• Widgets and daily reminders
• Apple Watch support
• Syncs seamlessly with iCloud
# Optional tracking, never pressure
• View trends and streaks if you want them
• Manually log sessions when needed
• No rankings, no goals, no gamification
# Built to last
• No subscriptions
• No ads
• No data harvesting
• Supported by optional donations
Center is not a course, a coach, or a content platform. It is a quiet instrument for mindfulness, offered with restraint and intention.
If Center supports your practice, you may choose to support its continued development.

With Box, you can:
• Use Box AI: ask questions, summarize documents, and automate workflows
• Manage files: upload, view, and search hundreds of file types with offline access
• Capture content: scan documents with OCR, take photos/videos, and record audio
• Collaborate: share files, co-edit Box Notes, annotate documents, and transcribe handwriting
• Secure data: protect files with enterprise encryption and compliance controls
–
** Featured by Apple in Best New Apps and Best New Business Apps
** “Box is an excellent choice for viewing, editing and sharing your files securely in the cloud.” ‐ CNET

• Access powerful AI tools directly within the app to ask questions, summarize documents, and extract insights instantly
• Switch between AI agents, clear chat history, and give feedback on AI responses to optimize your experience
• View source citations to verify answers and use formatting options for clearer, structured responses
• Access Box AI on your mobile device with Business, Business Plus, or any of the Enterprise plans

• Upload and view hundreds of file types including PDFs, Microsoft Office, and Google Workspace documents, and more
• Create Box Notes for ideas, to-do lists, and real-time project coordination
• Work offline with seamless access to files and folders
• Search instantly by file name and content type
• Edit, e-sign, annotate your work

• Scan documents with OCR to convert files into searchable PDFs
• Capture, edit, and enhance photos directly from your device
• Record audio and video with pause/resume controls before uploading
Collaborate and share:
• Share files with teammates or external collaborators securely with one click
• Work together in real time with Box Notes
• Annotate documents with typed or drawn feedback
• Convert handwriting to text using Apple Pencil on iPad
• Seamlessly content to partner app integrations
Secure your files and protect privacy:
• Prevent leaks across company and personal devices
• Enterprise-level security, compliance, and file encryption
• Choose flexible EMM options for device or app-level control
